about_the_game:
■ A Turn-Based Auto-Battler Roguelike: Build by Sticking


Seal of Magic is a turn-based auto-battler roguelike where you progress through battles by applying Seals to strengthen your allies.

At the start of the game, you choose two Spirits. You must determine the direction of your build based on their unique stats and passive abilities. The core feature of the game is combining the Seals you obtain after each battle to cultivate a completely different build for every run.

■ Build Crafting with Seal Effects and Stack Bonuses


Seals possess various effects, such as increasing Attack or Defense, or growing stats in response to specific actions.

Each Spirit has a 3x3 (9-slot) grid. Which Seals you place—and where you stack them—will drastically change your build.

When you stack a Seal on top of another, the bottom Seal's effect is lost. However, in exchange, a "Stack Bonus" is triggered, activating a powerful effect just once at the end.

■ Enemies Are Strengthened by Seals Too


The enemy side also applies Seals to strengthen themselves. Even when you defeat an enemy, the Seals applied to them remain for the duration of that run.

As a result, the enemy's Seal configuration and strength change as you progress, creating a unique experience where enemy abilities differ every run.

■ No Story, Just Pure Gameplay


This game is designed with the sole goal of letting players enjoy the strategy and build-crafting mechanics. Therefore, there are no story.
